headline: Japan Tobacco and Altria Mull Takeover of Imperial Brands
summary: Japan Tobacco and Altria are reportedly considering a takeover of UK cigarette maker Imperial Brands. Imperial Brands shares rose following the reports.
why: Imperial Brands is a major global tobacco manufacturer, and a potential cross-border acquisition by industry peers Japan Tobacco and Altria would significantly reshape the global tobacco sector.

impacts.name: Imperial Brands
impacts.why: Rumors of a potential takeover bid generally drive the target company's share price higher.
